'''''Kohleria hirsuta''''', the '''woolly kohleria''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Gesneriaceae]], native to northern South America, and introduced to the Dominican Republic.<ref name="381572-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:381572-1 |title=''Kohleria hirsuta'' (Kunth) Regel |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=8 June 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Kohleria hirsuta'' woolly kohleria |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/85947/Kohleria-hirsuta/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=8 June 2021 |quote=Synonyms; ''Kohleria eriantha'' }}</ref> In 1993, as its synonym ''Kohleria eriantha'', it gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]] as a hothouse plant, but this award appears to have been rescinded.<ref>{{cite web |title=Warm conservatory and greenhouse plants |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/advice/profile?pid=968 |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=8 June 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Kohleria eriantha'' woolly-flowered tree gloxinia |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/9779/i-Kohleria-eriantha-i/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=8 June 2021 }}</ref>

==Subtaxa==
The following varieties are accepted:<ref name="381572-1" />
*''Kohleria hirsuta'' var. ''hirsuta'' – entire range
*''Kohleria hirsuta'' var. ''longipes'' <small>(Benth.) L.P.Kvist & L.E.Skog</small> – Colombia
